defs.def: having a lot of influence on sb/sth 有很大影响的；有支配力的

ex.s: The world has always had influential people, for instance, but only now do we have “Influencer”.
ex.t: 例如，世界上一直都有有影响力的人，但只是到了现在，我们才有了“网红”这个词。

ex.s: For well over a hundred years the most influential English dictionary was Samuel Johnson's Dictionary of the English Language published in 1755.
ex.t: 一百多年来，最具影响力的英语词典是Samuel Johnson于1755年出版的《英语词典》。

ex.s: The tests show that the social environment is extremely influential when we’re making decisions.
ex.t: 测试表明，当我们做决定时，社会环境的影响极大。

ex.s: He is one of the most influential thinkers of all time.
ex.t: 他是有史以来最有影响力的思想家之一。

ex.s: It's a form of sport and entertainment which was influential in China for more than 2,000 years.
ex.t: 这是一种体育和娱乐形式，在中国影响了两千多年。

ex.s: As his longest play, it is considered among the most powerful and influential works of world literature.
ex.t: 作为他最长的戏剧，它被认为是世界文学中最强大和最有影响力的作品之一。

ex.s: His informal but sophisticated style of writing, in both Chinese and English, made him one of the most influential writers of his generation.
ex.t: 他非正式而又成熟的写作风格，无论是中文还是英文，使他成为他那一代最有影响力的作家之一。

ex.s: Edgar Snow was an American journalist who wrote influential books and articles about China in the 1930s.
ex.t: 埃德加·斯诺是一位美国记者，他在二十世纪三十年代写了关于中国的有影响力的书籍和文章。

chunks.cn: 瓷制品的有很大影响的
